output.headline: Kowalski hat-trick sinks Ironvale as Harbour City win 4-1
output.text: Ironvale Athletic's Zeke Mbeki had a 0.876 xG chance blocked from 2.5 in minute 2, then scored in minute 30 (xG 0.188, 96.1 km/h) after a 31.7-unit Luca Romero pass of difficulty 53. Harbour City's high press (PPDA 8.5 against 10.3) turned the match after the break. Leo Marchetti equalised in minute 49 from 0.024 xG. Dani Kowalski then scored in minute 62 (xG 0.06) and minute 81 (xG 0.057), and added a 0.79 xG tap-in from 2.5 in minute 90. Ironvale won the xG count 1.76 to 1.26 but converted 1 of 10 shots against Harbour City's 4 of 12. Kowalski, three goals from 1.17 xG, was the standout, and final momentum was 75.
